coordinate_system: Model origin; X right; Y up (-model Y); top view for every layer; bottom files are not mirrored
exclusions: Scoped geometry export, not fabrication readiness or clearance/continuity certification
No legacy previews, inner copper, pours, arcs, component through holes/slots, blind/buried/microvias, silkscreen, netlist/X3 assembly or material/finish/stackup instructions
Mask expansion applies only to legacy pads and untented vias; explicit mask rectangles are absolute. No manufacturer rules inferred.
Paste uses only explicitly stored pad rectangles; legacy pads have no inferred paste. All vias remain untented with no paste. No stencil suitability checks.
Incomplete explicit aperture coverage: legacy SMD pads have no paste policy; absent data is not intentional omission.
